name: Chuchu Heaven
source:
My name is Shoutaro. I'm a university student and I just started living in a dormitory. However what awaits me there were peculiar residents; a blond girl, a cosplay-fangirl, a miko and a priestess. When I first meet the blond girl, she said, "As you can see, I'm a true vampire."

When I was at a loss what to say, she also commanded, "Just be my slave!" Like this, my stormy life began involving other peculiar residents...

[Edited from ErogeShop]
translation:
我叫翔太郎，是一名刚开始住进宿舍的大学生。然而，在那里等待我的却是一群古怪住户：金发少女、热爱Cosplay的女孩、巫女和女祭司。第一次遇见金发少女时，她说道：“如你所见，我是一名真正的吸血鬼。”

就在我不知该如何回答时，她又命令道：“给我当奴隶吧！”就这样，我被其他古怪住户一同卷入，波澜万丈的生活拉开序幕……

[编辑自ErogeShop]
